integrity: An analytic proof supports all parameter and time quantifiers. A standalone rational-arithmetic checker tests selected monomial integrals and finite branch words; no independent audit or universal computational certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Stationary center observation under normalized planar Lebesgue measure; integer \(M\ge2\) and probabilities strictly between zero and one. Does not apply to arbitrary dependent switching, noisy measurements, or the complete planar process.
title: Exact path-law duality and observable information in heterochaos baker centers
